note: Notices from the site team to the requester. The operator reads this at the start of a conversation and delivers any notice whose date range covers today, before doing anything else. A notice past its range is no longer delivered.

howToWrite.id: unique name; include the date and a word about the subject
howToWrite.from: first day it is delivered (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive
howToWrite.to: last day it is delivered (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive
howToWrite.title: one line
howToWrite.body: what the requester should hear. The operator passes this through word for word
howToWrite.date: the date shown when it is delivered (YYYY-MM-DD). Falls back to `from` when absent

announcements.title: (example) this notice is not delivered
announcements.body: Its date range has passed, so the operator will not read it out. Add real notices below this one in the same shape.
